purpose: D-024 part-3 precondition: does history(extended_market_hours=True, fill_forward=False) deliver REAL pre-open bars?
findings: REGULAR fetch delivers 08:31-16:00 in CHICAGO stamps with ZERO bars in the 07:21-08:30 CT block - a live confirmation of L-021 and of why S-CASH cannot be built from the banked data path.
EXTENDED + fill_forward=False is ACCEPTED (no TypeError) and delivers 1379.8 bars/day spanning 00:00-23:59.
The 07:21-08:30 CT block prints EVERY minute (density 1.000, 70.0 bars/day against a 70-minute span).

pre_stale = 0.300: 30% of that block's closes equal the previous close. Forward-filling would leave ~100%; 30% is consistent with genuine trading on ZN's coarse 1/2-of-1/32 tick. The bars are REAL, not synthetic repeats.

The delivered span really is 00:00-23:59 (an extended Globex series crosses midnight), confirming the review's B1: the original part-3 timezone gate required the span to END at 16:00 and would have voided every part-3 run.
consequence: D-024 S-CASH arm is VIABLE. Proceed with the two-fetch part 3 (regular for D-009 factors, extended+FF-off for the analysis series). Coverage 1.000 clears the 0.80 floor.
